title: A Garden That Travels by Sea
paras: On a small [[yacht|yacht]] fitted out for long pleasure trips, engineer Leila Santos is testing a vegetable garden that rocks with the waves. Beneath a hanging [[lantern|lantern]], twelve lettuce plants grow in narrow trays. A leaf-shaped [[logo|logo]] identifies the control box: a homemade computer that manages their water supply.

Growing food at sea challenges the [[assumption|assumption]] that roots simply need regular watering. When a boat tilts, liquid collects at one end of a tray, leaving some roots dry and others underwater. Leila's trays contain a fabric that spreads moisture, while sensors activate tiny pumps. Without dissolved nutrients, the plants would effectively [[starve|starve]], even with plenty of water.

During an early trial, a blocked pipe caused a minor [[crisis|crisis]]: half the crop began to wilt. Leila, scratching a [[pimple|pimple]] on her chin as she examined the readings, initially blamed the software. The sensors were [[apparently|apparently]] reporting normal moisture levels, but they measured only one end of each tray. Adding a second sensor revealed the hidden dry patch.

Now small bean plants [[bloom|bloom]] beside the lettuce, although their flowers need protection from salty spray. The fresh leaves have become a source of [[envy|envy]] among neighbouring boat owners eating stored vegetables. Yet Leila does not claim that her garden can feed an entire crew. Its real value is showing how a modest change in measurement can turn an unreliable growing system into a useful source of fresh food.
zh: 在一艘为长途休闲航行配好设备的小游艇上，工程师莱拉·桑托斯正在测试一个随波摇晃的菜园。一盏悬挂的提灯下，十二株生菜长在狭长的种植槽里。控制盒上有一个叶片形徽标，里面是一台自制电脑，负责管理供水。
在海上种菜，挑战了“只要定期给根部浇水就行”这一未经证实的看法。船身倾斜时，水会聚集在种植槽的一端，导致部分根系干燥，另一些则泡在水中。莱拉在槽内铺了一种能让水分均匀扩散的织物，并用传感器启动微型水泵。如果水中没有溶解的养分，即使水量充足，植物实际上也会挨饿。
在早期的一次试验中，一根堵塞的管道引发了一场小危机：一半作物开始萎蔫。莱拉一边查看读数，一边挠着下巴上的一颗粉刺，起初以为是软件出了问题。传感器显示的湿度似乎正常，但它们只测量了每个种植槽的一端。加装第二个传感器后，那处隐蔽的干燥区域才暴露出来。
如今，生菜旁的小豆苗已经开花，不过花朵需要遮挡，以免受到咸水飞沫的侵袭。附近船主吃着储存的蔬菜，对这些新鲜菜叶很是羡慕。但莱拉并不声称她的菜园能养活全体船员。它真正的价值在于证明：对测量方式稍作调整，就能让一个不可靠的种植系统变成实用的新鲜食物来源。

q.s: Leila's homemade computer is powered by solar panels.
q.why: 文中介绍了电脑功能，未说明供电方式。

q.s: The boat's movement can leave different parts of a growing tray with unequal amounts of water.
q.why: 船身倾斜会使水聚集在种植槽的一端。

q.s: Leila claims that her garden can feed an entire crew.
q.why: 末段明确说她并不声称能养活全体船员。
